title: WAL shared-memory publication barrier

scope.rationale: walShmBarrier orders duplicated WAL-index header publication and validation plus read-lock snapshot checks, walIndexWriteHdr finalizes and publishes the two ordered copies, and walIndexTryHdr rejects mismatched, uninitialized, or checksum-invalid snapshots and adopts only a valid changed header.

dependencies.caller_closure: The helper, complete duplicated-header finalization/publication and read/validation/adoption owners, and read-lock validation call sites are integrated in the production WAL-index owner.

inputs: WAL owner with shared-file or connection-private heap-index mode
contracts.state_and_results: Issues a sequentially-consistent barrier unless exclusive heap-index mode makes the index connection-private.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Does not acquire WAL locks. Delegates shared-mode ordering to the process memory-barrier primitive.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible and leaves WAL fields unchanged.

representation_differences: The source delegates to sqlite3OsShmBarrier for a file-backed index. The internal Zig WAL owner delegates to its process sequentially-consistent barrier; the Unix production VFS separately implements the exact xShmBarrier mutex round-trip.

oracle.protocol: Exercise the shared and heap-index branches, then validate duplicated-header write/read and read-lock snapshot paths.
oracle.normalization: Barrier implementation details are normalized to the source ordering boundary.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Ordering call sites are integrated; cross-process concurrency stress remains pending.
assurance.performance: One sequentially-consistent barrier in shared mode and constant-time no-op in heap mode.

integration.native_call_path: Header publication, duplicate-header validation, and both read-lock snapshot checks invoke the helper.

independent_review.notes: Requires seeded concurrency trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add shared/heap barrier instrumentation and cross-process publication stress.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/wal_core.zig duplicated-header and read-lock paths plus src/core/mutex.zig and src/core/unix_vfs.zig barriers were reviewed
callers: walIndexWriteHdr between second and first header copy
walIndexTryHdr between first and second header reads
walTryBeginRead after read-lock acquisition and before shared-header validation
callees: mutex.memoryBarrier in the internal Zig owner
Unix VFS xShmBarrier for file-backed production transport
assertions_branches_cleanup: All generated blocks for the mapped helper and header read/write owners are assigned
Header publication requires the write lock
No ownership or cleanup paths exist
upstream_tests: Upstream WAL concurrency and WAL-index recovery tests exercise publication ordering
Project WAL tests cover both mode branches and integrated call sites
